title: Reconstruction Is Not Prescription
compression: Source-incompatible does not mean illegitimate thought.
source_reconstruction: Atlas may reconstruct what a source meant without treating that reconstruction as a rule for what later readers are allowed to think.
assumption_envelope: Historical fidelity and interpretive freedom are separate questions.
A transformation may be valuable while remaining different from the source meaning.
Attribution matters even when intellectual permission remains open.
decoder_prerequisites: Distinguish descriptive provenance from normative permission.
Distinguish faithful reconstruction from deliberate transformation.
candidate_invariants: A later interpretation may depart from a source without being forbidden.
A departure should not be attributed to the source as though it were faithful reconstruction.
cliffs: Do not turn source fidelity into intellectual orthodoxy.
Do not erase the source-transformation distinction in the name of interpretive freedom.
